title: Proposed study collaboration on GLUT1 deficiency syndrome

sentences.text: Invitation to discuss a research collaboration on GLUT1 deficiency syndrome
Dear Glut1 Deficiency Foundation team, you support families living with GLUT1 deficiency syndrome.
I am [name, role, institution], and I would value your view on a study idea.
Published work links SLC2A1-related disorders to haploinsufficiency, where one working copy is not enough.
Your natural history study includes people with this condition, and a registry and natural history study of epilepsy-dyskinesia syndromes is recruiting.
Triheptanoin trials have had mixed fates: one phase 2 study completed, while others were terminated, withdrawn or have unknown status.
Some trials enrol by syndrome without requiring an SLC2A1 variant, so their gene link is less direct.
We would propose [study aim and design], developed with families and run under ethics approval.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be willing to discuss the idea, and how your natural history study or community could take part with proper consent?
We are not asking for any names, contact details or records of patients or families.
If you are open to it, could we arrange a short call?
